question: An effect says 'All white creatures get +1/+1 until end of turn.' Does it affect a creature that enters the battlefield or turns white after the effect resolves?

expected.shortAnswer: No: it affects only the permanents that are white creatures when the effect resolves, even if they change color later.
expected.answer: An effect that reads “All white creatures get +1/+1 until end of turn” gives the bonus to all permanents that are white creatures when the spell or ability resolves—even if they change color later—and doesn’t affect those that enter the battlefield or turn white afterward.
